text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia on Wednesday commemorated Martyrs Day.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on Wednesday hosted a party for veterans of the fight for independence.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari on Wednesday held talks with visiting French Foregn Ministry Secretary-General Bertrand Dufourq on reinforcing bilateral cooperation.
- Computer and telecommunications exhibit started in the southern city of Sfax.
- Tunisia wants to develop fishing activities along the northern shore.
- Tunisia looks at the future of its textiles sector which exports mainly to European markets.
- As of the end of March, Tunisia had exported 17,596 tonnes of dates with the value of 46,460 million dinars in the currect season which began last October.
- Tunisia's telecommunication services expected to be about 100 percent digital by the year 2001.
